trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's complimentary Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft ~$25-35) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your park tickets and plans for the week.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick bite at the airport before baggage claim — try Burger King or Subway in the terminal to save money (~$10-12 per person). Pick up snacks at the resort gift shop or a vending machine for the room.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive well-rested mindset: get to bed as early as possible after check-in. Disney parks open early and lines are shorter in the morning. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight if you haven't already — it's free and essential for Lightning Lane, wait times, and dining reservations. Confirm your park reservations for the week.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive 30 minutes before opening (rope drop strategy) to beat the crowds. Start with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before lines build. Then rush to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the free My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Liberty Square and Frontierland — ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion. Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat (1–3 PM) at the air-conditioned Carousel of Progress or browse the shops on Main Street U.S.A. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade if scheduled (~3 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show (typically 9 PM). Grab a prime spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 45 minutes early. After fireworks, use the park exit crowds as your cue to head back to the resort. Take the complimentary Disney bus back to Aegean Bliss Resort.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the resort before heading out — grab a quick continental breakfast or pack granola bars and fruit from a grocery store run (~$3-5 per person). Avoid resort restaurant breakfast to save money.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with fish and chips, chicken sandwiches, and clam chowder (~$12-15 per person). Split a kids' meal if portions allow.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of the largest counter-service restaurants in Magic Kingdom with rotisserie chicken, burgers, and salads (~$13-16 per person). Free toppings bar adds great value.

day_by_day.notes: Pro budget tip: bring a refillable water bottle — Disney provides free ice water at any quick-service location. Avoid purchasing bottled water in the park (~$4 each). Pack your own snacks (granola bars, trail mix, fruit pouches) in a small backpack to cut food costs significantly. Sunscreen is essential in June — Florida heat is intense.

day_by_day.morning: Visit EPCOT — Disney's festival and innovation park. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to World Discovery for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book a virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane early via the app). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE before crowds peak.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase — stroll through 11 country pavilions representing nations from Mexico to Canada. Many pavilions offer free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and street performers at no extra cost. Stop in the Morocco, Japan, and France pavilions. If EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival is running (typically May–November), enjoy small tasting plates from global kiosks (~$4-8 per plate).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of Disney's most breathtaking free-included shows. Find a spot along the lagoon promenade. Head back to the resort via Disney bus after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort or pack snacks from your room to save time and money.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — EPCOT's best value quick-service with fresh rotisserie chicken, Asian noodle bowls, sandwiches, and salads (~$12-15 per person). Bright, air-conditioned, and spacious.
meals.dinner: World Showcase food kiosks (if Food & Wine Festival is active) — budget $20-25 per person for 3-4 small tasting portions from different countries. Alternatively, Regal Eagle Smokehouse in American Adventure serves budget BBQ plates (~$14-17).

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — wear comfortable shoes. The International Food & Wine Festival (if running in June 2027) is an incredible budget-friendly way to sample global cuisine without sit-down restaurant prices. Download the EPCOT map on the My Disney Experience app. Free water refills available at any quick-service counter.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios — the home of Star Wars and Toy Story. Arrive at rope drop. Immediately head to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge and ride Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides) using the boarding group or Lightning Lane. Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Both are best experienced early before lines exceed 90 minutes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Visit the Animation Courtyard for the Disney Junior Dance Party (great for families with young kids). Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show — a free, included live-action performance that runs multiple times daily and is a Hollywood Studios classic.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Fantasmic! nighttime show — a water, fire, and projection spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse. Check show times and arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seating (it's free with park admission). Afterward, browse Sunset Boulevard before heading back to Aegean Bliss Resort via Disney bus.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before departure or bring packed snacks.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of the most beloved counter-service spots with grilled cheese sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (tater tot nachos) (~$11-14 per person). Lines can be long — use mobile ordering via the My Disney Experience app.
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary near Echo Lake — quick-service with burgers, chicken, pasta, and plant-based options (~$12-15 per person). Air-conditioned and comfortable for a dinner break.

day_by_day.notes: Mobile ordering is highly recommended at Hollywood Studios — it saves significant time and you can order from the resort bus on your way in. Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge merchandise (lightsabers, droids) is tempting but very expensive — budget accordingly if purchasing. June heat peaks in the afternoon, so plan a rest break between 1–3 PM in an air-conditioned show or restaurant.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Disney's Animal Kingdom — Disney's nature and adventure park. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride with the longest waits) first thing — waits can reach 2+ hours by mid-morning. Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a more relaxed experience in the same area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and Asia sections of the park. Take the Kilimanjaro Safaris ride to see real animals including elephants, giraffes, lions, and rhinos — an incredible included experience. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for free up-close wildlife viewing. Catch the Finding Nemo: The Big Blue... and Beyond! musical show in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular or the Tree of Life Awakenings light show (check current schedule). Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM). Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a relaxed evening. Consider a resort pool swim to cool down and unwind — a great free activity.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort or eat from your snack supplies.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney World's highest-rated quick-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, protein choices, and unique beverages (~$13-16 per person). Use mobile ordering.
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — outdoor waterfront seating with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken (~$13-17 per person). One of Animal Kingdom's best value meals with a beautiful setting overlooking the water.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most outdoor-heavy park — sunscreen and hydration are critical. The morning safari is best for active animal sightings as animals are more energetic in cooler morning temperatures. This is a great day for families with young children due to the abundance of shows, trails, and character meet-and-greets. The resort pool is free to use — a great budget evening activity.

day_by_day.morning: Revisit your favorite park OR explore Disney Springs — Disney's free-to-enter shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Disney Springs opens at 10 AM. Browse unique Disney merchandise, watch street performers, and explore The LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and the outdoor marketplace. Admission is completely free.
day_by_day.afternoon: If at Disney Springs: visit the Marketplace area and check out the free entertainment stages. Browse the artisan marketplace vendors. Alternatively, use today as a resort relaxation day — swim at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool, recharge, and do laundry if needed. Or use a park hopper option to revisit a favorite park for specific rides you missed.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final Disney Springs dinner at a more relaxed pace. Watch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater if desired (~$15-18 per ticket) or enjoy free live music performances around the Springs waterfront area. Return to the resort at a leisurely pace — this is your rest night before the final full day.

meals.breakfast: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed resort breakfast — if the resort has a grab-and-go option, use it. Alternatively, stop at a nearby Publix or Walmart (short rideshare) to restock affordable snacks and drinks for the final days (~$15-20 total).
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings at a reasonable price (~$12-15 per person). Outdoor seating available.
meals.dinner: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — Guy Fieri's fast-casual chicken tender restaurant with 22 dipping sauces (~$10-14 per person). One of the best value sit-down-style meals at Disney Springs.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is an excellent free day activity — parking is also free if you drive. No park ticket is needed. This day is intentionally lighter to prevent theme park fatigue, which is common by Day 6 of a Disney trip. Use this time to purchase any souvenirs at World of Disney, which often has better prices than in-park shops. Check if your resort has any free scheduled activities or entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Final park day — choose your favorite park or one you want to revisit. Recommended: return to Magic Kingdom for any rides you missed or want to ride again. Arrive at rope drop for maximum time. Prioritize your must-do rides using the My Disney Experience app to check wait times. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs on Main Street U.S.A. (shops stay open 30 minutes after park closing).
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your final afternoon soaking in the magic. Visit any remaining attractions, take photos at iconic spots (Cinderella Castle, the EPCOT ball, Hollywood Studios water tower), and enjoy a final Disney treat — a Mickey-shaped ice cream bar (~$5) or Dole Whip at Magic Kingdom's Aloha Isle (~$6) are budget-friendly Disney classics.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by early evening. Pack your luggage and prepare for departure. Do a final check of your room for any left items. Order a rideshare or arrange airport transportation back to Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an amazing week at Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — use up any remaining snacks or grab-and-go items from your room to minimize spending on the last day.
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Café at Magic Kingdom — classic quick-service Tex-Mex with tacos, burgers, and nachos (~$12-15 per person). Great free toppings bar with lettuce, tomato, salsa, and more to stretch your meal.
meals.dinner: Early dinner before leaving the park — Columbia Harbour House or Casey's Corner (hot dogs from ~$8-10) for a quick, affordable final meal. Alternatively, grab food at the airport if your flight timing allows.

day_by_day.notes: Budget recap tip: A 7-day Disney World trip on a budget is very achievable. Key money-savers used this week: rope drop strategy (avoids Lightning Lane purchases), free included shows and parades, counter-service dining only, packed snacks and refillable water bottles, free Disney transportation, and Disney Springs for a no-ticket day. Total estimated food budget for the week: $60-90 per person. Always tip your resort housekeeping staff ($2-5/day) as they work hard to make your stay comfortable.

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange Disney's Magical Express or rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack, and settle into your Beachfront room.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night snack at the resort's lobby bar or quick-service location upon arrival — many Disney-area resorts offer 24-hour options or vending areas

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — arrival at 22:30 means priority is getting to the resort quickly and resting. Confirm your resort check-in is set for late arrival. Purchase a multi-day Disney Park ticket online in advance if not already done to save time. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize park time.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure begins — arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat crowds. Start with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin early before lines grow. Use Disney's Lightning Lane or Virtual Queue for top rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — head to Fantasyland for rides like Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight. Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise. Enjoy a mid-afternoon parade such as the Festival of Fantasy Parade on Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (check park schedule for exact time, typically 9:00 PM). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 45 minutes early.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort before heading out — try the resort's casual dining or grab a pastry and coffee at a resort café
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service offering clam chowder, fish and chips, and sandwiches in a charming nautical setting
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. — a table-service gem offering classic American comfort food like burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes at moderate prices; reserve in advance on the My Disney Experience app

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes — Magic Kingdom involves extensive walking. Download the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time. Stay hydrated; June in Orlando is hot and humid with temperatures often exceeding 90°F. Sunscreen is essential. Pick up a complimentary park map at the entrance.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — arrive early to secure a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of the most immersive rides in Disney history. Head straight to Galaxy's Edge upon park opening. Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (book in advance; approx. $250 per lightsaber — optional splurge).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore more of Hollywood Studios — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on Star Wars cockpit adventure. Head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Visit the Animation Courtyard and catch a live show. Check out the new Muppets attraction for family laughs.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — a dazzling water, fire, and projection spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse. Grab a Fantasmic! dining package for guaranteed seating (book in advance).

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with unique dishes like Felucian Garden Spread and Ronto Wraps; a fun and affordable Star Wars breakfast experience
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fan-favorite counter service with grilled cheese sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and Lunch Box Tarts at budget-friendly prices
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — a mid-range table-service restaurant where you dine in retro cars under a starlit sky watching classic sci-fi movie clips; order burgers, pasta, and milkshakes

day_by_day.notes: Book Savi's Workshop and any dining reservations at least 60 days in advance through the My Disney Experience app. Galaxy's Edge is extremely popular — arriving at rope drop is strongly recommended. Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge offers themed drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) and is a fun stop if you can snag a walk-up spot.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and Resort Day — take a well-deserved slower morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the beachfront amenities, pool, and resort grounds. Sleep in, have a leisurely breakfast, and recharge after two intense park days. Explore what the resort has to offer — beach access, water activities, or a morning stroll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining — head to Disney Springs in the early afternoon (free admission, no park ticket required). Browse the unique shops including World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and specialty boutiques. Catch a live street performance or browse the art galleries.
day_by_day.evening: Continue the Disney Springs Evening Experience — enjoy the vibrant entertainment district as it comes alive at night. Watch street performers, visit the House of Blues for live music, or catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater. Stroll along the waterfront and enjoy the festive atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a relaxed sit-down or buffet breakfast at the resort restaurant, taking in the beachfront views
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — a mid-range quick-service spot known for creative gourmet burgers, loaded fries, and hand-spun milkshakes; great value for the quality
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — a waterfront table-service restaurant with an impressive menu of fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American dishes; moderately priced with stunning views of the water; reserve in advance

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and offers free parking (arrive early for the best spots). This is a great day to purchase any souvenirs or Disney merchandise. The area is lively in the evenings with entertainment for all ages. Check the Disney Springs event calendar for any special performances or pop-up events on this date.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — arrive at EPCOT at rope drop and start with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature). Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (use virtual queue — join at park open) and Test Track. Visit the stunning Spaceship Earth geodesic sphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to World Showcase as it opens (typically 11:00 AM). Embark on the food and culture tour — begin at Mexico's San Angel Inn area and work clockwise through Norway (ride Frozen Ever After!), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisine, browse cultural pavilions, and enjoy live cultural performances at each country.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Find a great viewing spot along the lagoon promenade. Explore the illuminated World Showcase in the magical evening atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — a large EPCOT quick-service with a wide variety of fresh options including Asian noodle bowls, rotisserie chicken, and bakery items at reasonable prices
meals.lunch: World Showcase food stalls and kiosks — graze through multiple countries sampling small plates: try a School Bread pastry in Norway, Beef Gyoza in Japan, Crêpes in France, and Kielbasa in Germany; budget around $30–$50 for a satisfying multicultural lunch crawl
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — a lively teppanyaki table-service restaurant where skilled chefs cook hibachi-style right at your table; mid-range pricing with a fun, interactive atmosphere great for families; reserve well in advance

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the largest Disney park — comfortable footwear is critical. If EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival is running in June 2027, there will be additional food kiosks and entertainment throughout the park — a wonderful bonus. The Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind virtual queue fills up instantly at park open — have the app ready.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — arrive at park opening (typically 8:00 AM, one of the earliest-opening Disney parks). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the most in-demand ride at Animal Kingdom — use Lightning Lane or join the queue at rope drop). The queue itself is a visual masterpiece even before boarding.
day_by_day.afternoon: After Pandora, head to the Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa — a 20-minute open-vehicle safari through a stunning recreation of the African savanna where you'll spot real lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, rhinos, and more. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for close-up views of gorillas and exotic birds. Explore Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (prepare to get wet!).
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings — as dusk falls, the iconic Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery in a magical light show. Explore Discovery Island and enjoy the festive atmosphere as the park winds down.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the resort before heading to Animal Kingdom early — a granola bar, fruit, or quick café stop to fuel up for the morning rush
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – The World of Avatar — a visually stunning quick-service restaurant offering healthy and hearty bowls with grains, proteins, and unique sauces inspired by Pandoran cuisine; one of the best quick-service spots in all of Disney World
meals.dinner: Tusker House Restaurant in Africa — a popular character dining buffet featuring Donald Duck and friends in safari gear; the African-inspired buffet includes carved meats, couscous salads, hummus, and international dishes; moderate pricing and great for families

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom's Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active. Wear clothes you don't mind getting wet if riding Kali River Rapids. June heat can be intense — the park's lush jungle theming provides some shade. Check the schedule for any live animal demonstrations or conservation talks offered throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a relaxed breakfast and soak in the beachfront views one last time. Take a final stroll along the resort grounds or beach. Pack up, check out of the resort (standard checkout is typically 11:00 AM — request late checkout if your flight allows).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, consider a final quick visit to Disney Springs for any last-minute souvenir shopping or a relaxed lunch before heading to the airport. Alternatively, spend time at the resort pool if checkout allows. Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport with ample time — allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — board your return flight home with magical memories from a wonderful week at Disney World.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — treat yourself to a full sit-down meal and enjoy the beachfront ambiance one last time
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — quick, casual, and delicious options that won't slow down your departure timeline; affordable and family-friendly
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport or on the plane — MCO has solid dining options including Outback Steakhouse, Chick-fil-A, and various grab-and-go options in the terminals

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight departure time and arrange airport transportation the night before. Orlando International Airport (MCO) is approximately 25–30 minutes from Disney World — allow extra time during peak summer travel. Use the My Disney Experience app to relive your trip highlights and save your photos from PhotoPass if you purchased Memory Maker. Consider purchasing any remaining Disney merchandise at Disney Springs before heading to the airport.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. A pre-arranged private luxury transfer (limousine or premium SUV) whisks you directly to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity and late-night turndown service.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport before departure
meals.dinner: Light late-night room service at Aegean Bliss Resort — request the charcuterie board, artisan cheeses, and a bottle of champagne to celebrate your arrival in style

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange express check-in with the resort concierge so your suite is fully prepared upon arrival. Request early park entry wristbands, Disney MagicBands, and a personalized resort welcome packet from the concierge team. Keep Day 1 completely relaxed to recover from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort morning. After a lavish breakfast, head to Magic Kingdom Park for the full-day adventure. Arrive early to take advantage of Early Theme Park Entry (available to Disney resort guests). Prioritize Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane Premier Pass to skip the queues entirely.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure through the afternoon. Explore Fantasyland, ride Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean, and catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort's private lounge or a shaded restaurant to recharge before the evening magic.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Disney Enchantment fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle — best viewed from the premium reserved fireworks viewing area available to luxury resort guests. End the night with a relaxing private transfer back to Aegean Bliss Resort.

meals.breakfast: Signature resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's premier waterfront restaurant — fresh-squeezed juices, eggs Benedict, and seasonal fruit platters
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom — dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle with a prix-fixe lunch menu featuring French-inspired cuisine in a breathtaking setting
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a once-in-a-lifetime character dining experience with a premium prix-fixe menu featuring filet mignon, pan-seared salmon, and decadent desserts

day_by_day.notes: Book Cinderella's Royal Table and Be Our Guest Restaurant 60 days in advance via the Disney dining reservation system — these are among the most sought-after tables in all of Walt Disney World. Purchase Lightning Lane Premier Pass at 7:00 AM for maximum ride efficiency.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for the World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Begin with a guided premium tour of the World Showcase's 11 country pavilions. Start in Japan and Mexico, sampling authentic ramen, sushi, street tacos, and margaritas. Explore the artisan shops and cultural exhibits at a relaxed, immersive pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour through the UK, France, Italy, and Germany pavilions. Sample crêpes in France, gelato in Italy, and craft beer in Germany. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion and Frozen Ever After in Norway. Explore the new World Discovery area and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind.
day_by_day.evening: Witness the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium reserved viewing spot through the resort concierge. Afterward, enjoy a leisurely stroll through the illuminated pavilions before a private transfer back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: In-room private dining at Aegean Bliss Resort — custom-ordered continental spread with pastries, smoked salmon, fresh fruit, and premium coffee service
meals.lunch: Monsieur Paul in the France Pavilion at EPCOT — an upscale French restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse, offering duck confit, bouillabaisse, and an exceptional wine list
meals.dinner: Topolino's Terrace – Flavors of the Riviera at Disney's Riviera Resort (a short Disney Skyliner ride from EPCOT) — rooftop dining with panoramic views, featuring Italian and French Riviera-inspired cuisine with a character breakfast option

day_by_day.notes: The EPCOT Food & Culture experience pairs beautifully with the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during festival season (typically July–November). Ask the concierge about booking a private World Showcase culinary walking tour with a Disney cast member guide.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a resort spa morning — book a couple's or family massage treatment at Aegean Bliss Resort's luxury spa to recharge mid-trip. Take a leisurely swim at the beachfront pool with private cabana service. A perfect rest day before the immersive Hollywood Studios experience in the afternoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Begin with Savi's Workshop to build your own custom lightsaber — a deeply personal and emotional experience for all ages. Follow with the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run ride, then queue for the immersive Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance attraction using Lightning Lane Premier Pass.
day_by_day.evening: Remain at Hollywood Studios for the nighttime spectacular — Fantasmic! at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater. Book the premium Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed reserved seating. Cap the night with a walk through the illuminated Sunset Boulevard before a luxury transfer back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Poolside breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront cabana — tropical smoothies, avocado toast, eggs to order, and freshly baked pastries delivered to your private cabana
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina inside Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — the galaxy's most famous watering hole serving exotic themed cocktails, non-alcoholic concoctions, and shareable snacks in an immersive alien atmosphere (reservations essential)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant at Hollywood Studios — dine in a vintage convertible car under a simulated starry night sky watching classic sci-fi film clips, with a menu featuring prime steaks, lobster bisque, and indulgent milkshakes

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building experience costs approximately $299 per lightsaber and must be reserved well in advance — it sells out weeks ahead. Consider also booking the Droid Depot experience at Galaxy's Edge to build a custom R-series or BB-series astromech droid.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar experience. Begin with the Kilimanjaro Safaris at park opening for the best wildlife activity — lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos are most active in the cool morning hours. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Soar on Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's crown jewel attraction) using Lightning Lane Premier Pass. Experience Na'vi River Journey through bioluminescent rainforest. Explore the floating mountains and vibrant alien landscape of Pandora at a leisurely luxury pace.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show at Animal Kingdom or transition to a private VIP experience. Alternatively, enjoy an exclusive behind-the-scenes Wild Africa Trek — a private guided expedition across rope bridges over crocodile pools and exclusive savanna viewing platforms, available as a premium add-on.

meals.breakfast: Early-morning resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — power breakfast with protein-rich options to fuel a full park day: omelets, smoked meats, fresh-pressed juices, and granola parfaits
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most artistic fine dining experience, celebrating the spirit of global exploration with dishes like whole-fried sustainable fish, braised short rib, and a curated international wine and cocktail menu
meals.dinner: Nomad Lounge (adjacent to Tiffins) for craft cocktails and shareable plates at sunset, followed by in-resort private dining back at Aegean Bliss Resort — request the chef's tasting menu with wine pairing for an intimate in-suite experience

day_by_day.notes: The Wild Africa Trek is a premium add-on experience costing $189–$249 per person and runs approximately 3 hours. It includes a private guide, gourmet African-inspired snack spread on the savanna, and photo package. Book through Disney's special experiences line at least 30 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full resort morning — sleep in, indulge in a private beachfront yoga or fitness session arranged by the resort concierge. Take a final swim at the luxury pool with cabana service. Use this morning for souvenir shopping at the resort boutiques or relaxing spa treatments.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining for a relaxed, park-free afternoon. Explore the curated luxury shopping at Anthropologie, Chapel Hats, and the massive World of Disney flagship store. Visit the LEGO Store and build custom creations. Enjoy live entertainment from street performers and musicians throughout the open-air promenade.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the full evening at Disney Springs for a premium entertainment and dining extravaganza. Visit the Cirque du Soleil: Drawn to Life show — a breathtaking acrobatic performance celebrating Disney animation (book premium front-and-center seating). End the trip's final full evening with a nightcap at the Paddlefish rooftop bar overlooking the water.

meals.breakfast: Champagne brunch at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — eggs royale, lobster benedicts, fresh oysters, and bottomless mimosas in a beachfront setting
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — an upscale waterfront dining experience featuring fresh Florida stone crab claws, whole Maine lobster, prime dry-aged steaks, and amphicar boat tours of the waterway
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Asian dining experience featuring Peking duck carved tableside, sushi platters, wagyu beef dim sum, and an award-winning sake and cocktail program

day_by_day.notes: Cirque du Soleil: Drawn to Life tickets for premium seating range from $75–$175 per person and should be booked at least 2–3 weeks in advance. Disney Springs is free to enter with no park ticket required, making it a perfect low-key luxury evening. Validate parking or arrange resort shuttle.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Take one last walk along the beachfront, enjoy a relaxed checkout breakfast, and soak in the resort ambiance. Resort concierge will arrange luggage handling and a private luxury transfer to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart for Orlando International Airport in a pre-arranged private luxury vehicle. Allow ample time for check-in and security. Browse the airport's premium lounges — access the United Club or Centurion Lounge (with eligible card membership) for pre-flight refreshments, spa treatments, and comfortable seating.
day_by_day.evening: Board your return flight. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic, world-class dining, and unforgettable family memories.

meals.breakfast: Farewell breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's waterfront restaurant — order your personal favorites from the week, perhaps a final eggs Benedict, tropical fruit platter, and premium coffee or tea service
meals.lunch: Airport dining at the United Club lounge or a premium Orlando International Airport restaurant such as Vino Volo wine bar for charcuterie, artisan sandwiches, and curated wine selections
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or upon arrival at home destination

day_by_day.notes: Request a 12:00 PM or later checkout from Aegean Bliss Resort to maximize your final morning. The resort concierge can store luggage after checkout if needed. Confirm your private airport transfer 24 hours in advance. Consider purchasing a Disney PhotoPass Memory Maker package to download all professional photos taken throughout the week — a priceless keepsake of the entire trip.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
